regime_context: Theme momentum ranks are a focus lens with no validated return-forecast edge (rank-IC ~0). The absolute-trend gate is the only historically validated risk-control edge (gate_helps=true), helping to reduce drawdowns. The lead theme is fading (val_state) with zero breadth; the strongest durable trend is in Cybersecurity, albeit crowded. Macro backdrop dominated by AI-tech and geopolitics, but is coincident and not actionable. With no track record (n=0), all leans carry low conviction.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows a robust trend (hurst trending, breadth 1.0) with high durability (0.9), indicating broad participation. The absolute-trend gate confirms eligibility, supporting continued exposure from a risk-control perspective. Although crowded (crowding_z=2.22), guardrails dictate this is a size-down caution only, not a fade signal. Overweight is a directional tilt; actual sizing is owned by the allocator.
theses.dissent: Crowding may precede mean-reversion or positioning unwind; high durability could be a coincident peak if inflows have already exhausted trend-followers. Momentum rank has near-zero IC, so continuation is not guaranteed.

falsifier.text: If durability falls below 0.7 or breadth drops below 0.5 within 20 trading days, the overweight thesis is invalidated.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite the top rank, the theme is flagged as fading (val_state fading, r10 -12.7%) with zero breadth and mixed Hurst. Durability is low (0.5), and the absolute-trend gate alone does not provide a positive bias—only drawdown control. Given no predictive edge from rank, avoiding new allocations is prudent while the fade persists.
theses.dissent: Low breadth may reflect temporary consolidation; a fresh catalyst (e.g., HBM demand surprise) could quickly revive the theme and lead to a missed snapback.

falsifier.text: If durability returns to ≥0.7 and breadth rises to ≥0.5, and val_state shifts from fading to trending, the avoid call is no longer supported.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
